changes: Dialogue buttons use a fixed CSS-pixel font matching the body text setting. Labels wrap at that size and each shared row grows to fit, with at least 44px height. Existing choice objects, hit testing, shortcuts, disabled states and exactly-once actions are retained.

A compact dialogue panel is anchored above the screen safe-area bottom. Short text uses its measured height and longer passages use available reading space with visual paging. The 3D viewport extends into unused portrait space during conversation; movement/look controls are hidden. Camera framing accounts for the panel. Layout and label measurements are cached until content, font or viewport changes.

Native and classic conversations correct player/NPC overlap by checking nearby floor positions and the full swept path for body clearance, other actors, walls, water, height changes and line of sight. The player steps back on safe floor; the NPC remains at its authored coordinates and turns to the player. Original facing and view are restored on exit. No duplicate speaker sprite is created.

Beds offer direct Rest. Real campfires offer Cook & craft, Rest and Leave. Rest advances the saved client clock from day to 19:00 or night to 07:00. Existing Hermit rest follows the same rule. Combat, nearby visible enemies and out-of-reach points reject rest. No silver, XP, healing or server-global clock reward is added.

Items → Quest Items includes stored quest-prefixed supplies plus read-only projections of carried tower and apprenticeship objects: rescue rope, salvaged food chest, tribute/family roll, costume parcel, recommendation, sealed ledger/dispatch, packed meal, recovery draughts and relief bandages. Existing saves populate from their original flags; used or delivered objects disappear. These projections are not added as duplicate stacks and cannot be sold or consumed independently.

Quest objects have compact item sprites in both list and icon views; counts and destination descriptions remain visible in details. Existing quest supplies keep their recipe/handoff logic, quest sale protections and story-specific actions. Cherry retains her existing art.

Current devlog identifies v112 and condenses earlier logs. The package remains five files, with matching server metadata and preserved dependencies, map geometry, later story arcs and Dragonflight server section.
